batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b L Balaji

batting.dismissal: c MC Henriques b R Rampaul

batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b R Vinay Kumar

balls.text: fuller delivery wide outside off, the batsman gets some bat under it as he drives it over cover, they come back for a second
another slower delivery outside off, the batsman waits and pushes it to the off side for a single
and another one for Balaji, it was a slower length delivery on off stump, Kartik tries to whack it to the long side, but the ball arrives after the bat swing is complete, knocks back the offstump
slower bouncer, the batsman swings his bat at that one, but the ball arrives late and just goes over the stumps. The non-striker calls for bye
he tries to play the reverse paddle at a full delivery outside off, ala AB, but he makes no connection
he bowls it full and on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to long off with soft hands and is quick to come back for the second
he comes forward and dabs it towards point with soft hands and calls for a quick single
bowls a quicker offspinner, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
fuller delivery, turning away, the batsman swings his bat again, a bit half-hearted though, it balloons towards wide long on where Manoj Tiwary had plenty of time to get under it
fuller delivery, the batsman tries to smash it to the on side, but gets a bottom edge towards midwicket. they come back for a second as the fielder is too deep

fuller delivery on the stumps, the batsman tries to go across the line with a sweep shot, but he misses and is hit right in front of the stumps. Easy decision for the umpire and the Purple Cap flies into the head of Narine
bowls a quicker delivery that goes away from the right-hander, Vinay pushes it to cover for a single
back of length delivery that hits the pads of the batsman as he tries to push it off the back foot, but that pitched outside leg
length delivery angling across the batsman, Rampaul tries to fish for it outside off, is beaten
back of length delivery delivery on the stumps, the batsman dabs it towards midwicket for a single
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman makes room by moving outside leg and ramps it over point for a couple
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman plays inside the line and is beaten

caught at long on! Another batsman falls, he tries to whack the length delivery out of the ground, but it comes a touch slow of the pitch and the batsman ends up hitting it high, rather than long. Easy catch for Tiwary
he comes down on his knee and paddles the offspinning delivery fine on the leg side for a welcome boundary
fuller delivery on off stump, the batsman comes right behind it in defence
he goes on the back foot to a conventional offspinner and dabs it to backward point
the batsman didn't have a clue as he came forward to defend this one, it turned away and took an outside edge to short third man

quicker delivery this time, Tiwary comes forward in defence, a bit late and that was Narine's other one, it pitches on off, straightens a touch and hits him in front of off, below the knee-roll. Good decision by the umpire as the bat was close too
bowls it slow and on the stumps, the batsman waits and then defends it it to the off side
back of length delivery wide outside off, the batsman dabs it towards point for a quick single
he goes for the reverse paddle to a full and wide delivery, but he ends up playing it straight into the hands of the keeper. Balaji is pumped
there comes the big shot! Balaji attempts another slower yorker, but it just ends up being a half volley, and it's hammered over extra cover

that's the back of the hand slower delivery, the batsman has to generate the pace on that as he drives it to deep cover. He calls for two, but he was struggling to get back to his end, he dives and it's a super dive as he makes it in time
he bowls the yorker wide outside off this time, the batsman stretches out and manages to push it to deep cover
he bowls a full delivery on the off stump which the batsman drives it firmly to wide long off for a couple
he shuffles around in the crease before the ball is bowled, Bhatia bowls it down the leg side in response, but AB paddles it fine on the leg side for the first boundary in ages
this one is the offcutter, the batsman comes forward and pushes it down to long on
full and slower, the batsman can only dig it out back to the bowler
he bowls a leg cutter and it really turns like a legspinner, the batsman waits and pushes it to cover for a single
length delivery outside off, the batsman clears his front foot out and drives it firmly to deep cover
slower loopy delivery on the stumps, the batsman whips it to deep midwicket for a single
this is the other one, but it was too full, AB comes forward and drives it down the ground to long off
he waits in the crease and punches it firmly to deep cover for a single
he pushes it to cover, where another fumble allows the batsman to come back for a couple
he dabs it towards short third man for a single, but an overthrow at non-striker's allows an extra run

tossed up delivery on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward to defend, but the ball turns in, hits the pad and lobs up, Tendo comes in from midwicket and takes the catch, but that didn't hit the pad

this one is flatter and it pitches on a length on leg stump, then it turns past Gayle's outside edge. The batsman was coming forward to defend that, but his back leg was on the line! He didn't even try to drag it in..Bisla was quick to spot that

oh what an anti climax that shot turned out to be! AB was ready with his reverse sweep, and Sena bowled if full and wide outside off, AB then gets a thick top edge that goes over the keeper's head, but stops right after crossing the inner circle
tossed up and slow, outside off, the batsman dabs it towards midwicket for a single. The bowler runs around and does the fielding
quicker one on the stumps, AB comes forward and drives it down to long on
tossed up and full on the pads, Gayle comes forward and pushes it to deep midwicket
pushed through outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to long on
tossed up delivery on the pads, Gayle sweeps it softly towards square leg for a single
he bowls it full on the stumps, the batsman punches it to deep extra cover
he tries to go aerial on this fuller delivery, but doesn't get hold of it. Luckily for AB, it falls short of Tiwary at long off
another slower length delivery on off stump, Gayle punches it down to long off for a single
slower length delivery outside off, the batsman waits and then punches it hard to deep extra cover
back of length delivery outside off, this time Gayle goes for a forceful punch, but he inside edges it to short fine leg
slower delivery, very slow and very full, the batsman waits and waits and then punches it to deep extra cover
he makes room by moving outside leg and punches the back of length slower delivery through to deep extra cover
he bowls another slower delivery on off stump, the batsman tries to push it to the off side, but it hits the inside half and goes down the pitch
back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman pushes it to deep midwicket calmly for a single
another slower delivery, this time from back of length. AB pushes it to the left of cover for a quick single
slower bouncer outside off, beats AB as he plays his pull too early, turns around to see the ball still going to the keeper
length delivery outside off, the batsman drives it off the front foot, straight to cover
he comes forward to a low trajectory delivery, pushes it in the gap at deep midwicket for a couple
here comes the reverse sweep! It was a flatter and shorter delivery outside off, AB sweeps it to short third man
tossed up delivery on the pads, Gayle pushes it softly towards deep midwicket
comes forward and drives it to long on for a single
he bowls it on the pads, flighted delivery, it hits the pads on it's way to short fine leg
he bowls it on the pads, the batsman pushes it towards deep midwicket off the front foot
slower delivery on a length around off stump, Gayle defends it off the back foot towards cover
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits for it, then runs it down to third man

he has chopped it on! It was a length delivery, wide outside off, probably didn't bounce as much as Kohli thought it would, and he gets an inside edge back on to his stumps.. Delight for Kallis, despair for Kohli
he stays in the crease and clips the length delivery to deep midwicket for a couple
short of length delivery on the pads, Gayle stays calm and nudges it to midwicket for a single
he bowls it back of length around off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and opens the face of the bat late to run it down to third man
now the bat is moving a bit faster, he comes forward and drives it hard to wide long off for a couple
slower delivery and it's full too, that's what Gayle needed. He just chips it over the bowler's head, no power there, but it clears the boundary
back of length delivery that is wide outside off, slower too, Gayle calmly pushes it to the left of point for a single
this time he waits in the crease and turns the back of length delivery towards deep midwicket
slower length delivery outside off, Kohli breaks the boundary drought with a wristy late cut that thread the gap at backward point, beautifully hit
bowls a slower length delivery wide outside off, the batsman drives it down to long off for a single
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman waits for it and turns it behind square on the leg side for a quick couple
another of those cutters by Kallis, Gayle comes forward and pushes it calmly to long on for a single
back of length delivery on off, no pace on it, the batsman steers it to third man
bowls a length delivery on the pads, the batsman tickles it to short fine for a single
length delivery on the pads, the batsman gets a bit square up in his defence.
bowls it back of length outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man
he goes on the back foot and dabs it to the right of midwicket fielder for a quick single
quicker one this time, the batsman goes back and defends it to midwicket
loopy delivery outside off, it's full too, and Virat plays his trademark whippy drive through cover, no stopping that
tossed up delivery, slower too, the batsman comes forward and defends it solidly
quicker on the pads again, the batsman tickles it to square leg and Kohli wants a single, but he makes it in just in time
he bowls on the leg and middle line, Gayle gets a leading edge back to the bowler
quicker delivery on off stump, the batsman goes back and opens the face to play it towards short third man
he goes on the back foot and punches the flatter delivery back to the bowler
fuller delivery on off stump, the batsman digs it out to mid on and calls for a quick single

caught at cover point! he comes down the pitch and tries to loft Senanayake inside out, but he was not to the pitch of the delivery and gets a toe-end that lobs up for Balaji, who back pedals a couple of steps to take an easy catch
pushes this one a bit quicker, but it's on the leg side and Gayle nudges it to backward square leg for a single
tossed up and slower this time, Gayle comes forward and defends
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman nonchalantly punches it and it hurtles towards extra cover, where Tendo makes a good save
he bowls it fuller and wider outside off, the batsman watches it go through, but it is a wide
keeps bowling it slower to Gayle, the batsman comes forward and defends it to off side
length delivery that goes across the batsman, a touch slower too, the batsman leaves it alone
short of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman waits for it and guides it to third man
he appeals for an lbw, but there was an inside edge on to the thigh pad there. It was bowled a touch fuller and from wide of the crease, the batsman played outside the line
he bowls it back of length and angling in, the batsman punches it to mid off off the back foot
tossed up and full, the batsman comes forward  and drives it firmly down to long on
fuller this time, on off stump, the batsman takes one small step forward and pushes it to deep midwicket for a single
slower delivery this time, the batsman comes forward and defends it to cover
he comes forward and gets right behind the line of the ball, pushes it back to the bowler
this one was edged! And it quickly flew through the left of Kallis one slip, hard to call that a drop.. It flew really quickly
he bowls it quicker from round the stumps, the batsman tucks it to short fine
length delivery, touch slower too, the batsman defends it back to the bowler off the front foot
length delivery on the pads, Gayle goes on the back foot and nudges it to midwicket
beats the bat which angles across Gayle, seams a touch away and Gayle was surprised as he hung his bat at that one
another length delivery outside off, the batsman steers it to third man
length delivery from wide of the crease, the batsman waits in the crease and pushes it to cover
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to the leg side off the front foot
tossed up, the batsman comes down the pitch and takes it on the full, drives it to deep midwicket
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman easily pushes it to long on for a single
flatter and quicker on the stumps, the batsman stays in the crease and punches it to long on
another tossed up delivery, pushed back to the bowler
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives to mid off
he bowls it flat from round the wicket, the batsman comes forward and defends

slower delivery, Tendo spots it and he slaps it over the bowler's head. Henriques tries in vain to get to that from long-on, but that makes it easily over the boundary.. Tricky win this one. .But a win nonetheless
he bowls a good low full toss on off stump, the batsman pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single
slower delivery on the stumps, it's a touch slower, the batsman swats it to deep midwicket
now Bhatia has a wild slog at a length delivery, but that one is nowhere near the bat..
he walks across the stumps and tries to heave the length delivery to the leg side, but he drags it to square leg. He completes a risky single
full delivery on the stumps, Tendo drives it over mid on, just over him.. But that is enough for four very useful runs
he has a swish towards the leg side at that one, but it was another slower delivery wide outside off, misses it completely
bowls a slower length delivery that beats the batsman as he tries to cut it behind square
bowls a super yorker on the off stump, the batsman manages to dig it out towards third man for a single

back of length delivery, it is dabbed towards point and they take a quick single. But Gayle was quick and he throws the stumps down at the striker's end. Tension everywhere as the umpire calls for a review, but he has made it back in time

caught at cover! Of all the places the batsman could have hit this knee-high full toss, he chooses the worst place, hits it towards cover where Kohli dives to his left to complete a good low catch.. This isn't over yet..
he bowls it full this time and the batsman drives it straight to mid off
short delivery outside off, the batsman tries to play a tennis forehand on that, but gets a bottom edge to the keeper
he bowls a low full toss and Tendo flicked it just over midwicket where Kartik is not able to wrap his hands around that one as it flew over his head
slower bouncer on the stumps, the batsman pulls it to deep backward square leg for a couple
he clears his front foot out and whacks the length delivery outside off through extra cover with a lot of power

caught at mid on! He can afford a smile now. It was a slower delivery on a length and Kallis looked to clear the mid-on fielder, but he ended up dragging this one up in the air. Henriques back pedals and completes an easy catch
he gets his yorker right this time, it is just outside off, the batsman digs it out back to the bowler
he attempts a slower one, but he bowls it down the leg side
fuller length ball on the stumps, this time Kallis gets it from the middle, he smashes it through square leg for a boundary
he bowls a quick short delivery outside off, Kallis tries to pull it but he gets  a thick top edge that flies over the keeper's head
he tries to whack a full delivery to deep midwicket boundary, but he plays outside the line. The ball though, misses the stumps just by a whisker
comes down the pitch and drives the full delivery down to long on for a single
this is full outside off and the batsman drives it down to extra cover
he comes down the pitch again and takes the tossed up delivery on the full, whips it straight to midwicket
he starts walking out of the pitch and Kartik fires it wide outside off, this time Tiwary misses and AB takes off the bails. But Tiwary just managed to drag his foot back
he comes down the pitch, but the bowler fires it full and wide. The batsman pushes it to cover
another short of length delivery, the batsman works it towards deep square leg for a single
short of length slower ball on the off, the batsman waits and then drags it to deep midwicket for a single
short of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman hops and tucks it to fine leg
length delivery outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat very late and steers it to third man
he tries to drive the length delivery through the leg side, but it was a touch slower, he plays it in the air and it just falls short of Gayle at midwicket
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
he bowls a slower one, but this one goes down the leg side
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman tucks it to midwicket and thinks about a single, but Kallis sends him back
short and wide, but it's a slower delivery, the batsman has to wait and then he punches it to deep cover
another length delivery outside off, the batsman steers it past point for a single
length delivery on off stump, the batsman waits for it and guides it down to third man
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman hops on to his toes and nudges it towards square leg
he bowls a good short delivery aimed at the throat, the batsman somehow plays it towards third man, he had taken his eye off that one..
he makes some room, but the bowler bowls it wide outside off, the batsman stretches and pushes it towards off side for a single
he makes room, but Kartik fires it quick and in the blockhole, the batsman digs it out
he comes down the pitch again, but this time it's a flatter delivery, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
tossed up delivery on the pads, Tiwary comes down the pitch again and lofts it over mid on
tossed up delivery that drifts into the batsman, Tiwary jumps down the pitch, but hits it straight to midwicket
length ball on the pads, the batsman pushes it to deep midwicket for a single
beautifully hit! He gets the pace for that kind of shot from the bowler. It was length and Tiwary charges down the pitch, thumps it over the non-striker's head for a straight boundary
length delivery on off, the batsman waits for it and then pushes it to cover
he takes a step down the pitch and pushes it to mid on for a single. Gayle runs in from midwicket and does a dummy throw, but he almost walks into the line of mid-on's throw..
slower length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to push it to off, but gets an inside edge to square leg
he comes forward and drives the length ball to deep cover for a single
length delivery that angles across the right-hander, the batsman comes forward and lets it go through
full and flighted, the batsman comes down the pitch to whip it to the leg side, but gets an inside edge on to his pads, which then goes past the diving slip fielder
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and drives it to long off for a single
tossed up delivery on the pads, Tiwary flicks it to short fine and starts taking off, but he is sent back in time. A throw comes in, but Tiwary just makes it back in time

Murali strikes! He bowls a quicker and shorter delivery, the batsman shapes for a sweep, but the batsman gets hit on the thigh pad round about the leg stump line. The umpire raises his finger and Murali Kartik just goes ballistic. Was there a glove on that though? Need to look at that again
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman tucks it to midwicket
he bowls it quick and flat on the stumps, the batsman brings his bat down a little late in defence
slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to midwicket for a single
short of length delivery, the batsman waits for it and upper cuts it over the keeper's head for a cheeky boundary
he bowls a slower delivery full on the stumps, the batsman punches it to mid on
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to long off
he bowls a slower delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to cover and thinks about a single, but Yusuf sends him back as the point fielder charges towards it
he charges down the pitch and drives the length ball straight down the ground, between the umpire and mid-off, it races to the boundary
short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman dabs it to point
he walks down the pitch and pushes the length delivery to long on with soft hands, the batsmen think about a second
he bowls length on off stump, the batsman defends it to off off the front foot
goes for the yorker, but it's a low full toss that Pathan punches in the gap at deep midwicket. Unadkat there flicks the ball to Rampaul, but he is too slow, the batsmen come back for a third
he bowls a short delivery outside off, the batsman lets it go through
he bowls length on the stumps, Kallis whips it to deep square leg for a single
again makes some room, and drives the length delivery to wide long on
he moves away on the leg side, but drives the full delivery back to the bowler
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
pushed through on the pads, the batsman nurdles it towards backward square leg for a single
bowls quicker and shorter this time, the batsman cuts it straight to point
there you go! that is an Yusuf special! Tossed up delivery on off, the batsman gives it a proper thwack over long on, it goes high and high and deep into the stands
length delivery just outside off, the batsman pushes it to point off the front foot
length delivery on off stump, the batsman steers it to third man for a single
it kicked off from a length, hits the batsman's gloves and shoots towards point.. Yusuf gets hit on the finger, but he is lucky that the ball didn't go all the way to the fielder
quick short delivery by the bowler, Kallis ducks under it, but that was too high for the umpire
short of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pulls it down to deep backward square leg  and comes back for a second
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot and cracks it to third man
he bowls a length ball on the pads, the batsman flicks it fine on the leg side and Mithun at fine leg makes a good diving save
he spoons up a knee-high full toss straight towards mid-on, very lucky as this one falls a couple of meters short of the fielder

caught at slip! Vinay takes the big fish! It was a short of length delivery angling in from round the stumps, just outside off stump and Gambhir goes hard on it - he has done this many times in internationals - ends up getting a thick outside edge to the lone slip. It's Gayle there.
he bowls a good yorker, the batsman was moving down the pitch, but he just manages to jam it down on the pitch. It bounces and then sticks in the grill of the helmet
another short delivery, Gambhir had walked down towards off side, then lets it go..
goes for a full delivery, but this one is down the leg side
he bowls a short delivery from round the stumps, it comes a touch slow after pitching, Gambhir pulls it straight to short fine leg
he bowls a length delivery that swings away a touch, Kallis drives it through cover, on the up
bowls a slower delivery on the off stump, it is short enough for Kallis to pull it to deep square leg
length delivery outside off, Gambhir waits in the crease and steers it to third man for a single
back of length delivery on off stump, 131 kph, the batsman pushes it to wide mid on for a single
back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman tries to flick it fine on the leg side, but he gets a leading edge over midwicket
he jumps down the pitch and slaps the length ball down the ground, but it is hit straight to mid on
he bowls a short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
length delivery wide outside off, Gambhir stays in the crease and picks the spot at point nicely, no one moves as he threads it with precision
tries a slower delivery, but it's too short and wide, Gambhir wait and then slaps it hard through cover point
short delivery outside off, Gambhir gets this one on the middle of the bat, he carves it over point with an upper cut, it almost goes all the way
a quick length delivery outside off, Gambhir tries to blast it through off side but is beaten by the pace
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman chops it on to point
he bowls length from round the wicket and Gambhir plays a drive inside the line. It somehow misses the off stump too..
quick short delivery that rises up on the batsman. Kallis pulls but is beaten by the bounce on that one
another back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman doesn't get a bat on it. It hits the pads and rolls towards short fine. Unadkat there unnecessarily hits the stumps and they take an overthrow
he bowls short of length and angles it in to the left-hander, the batsman defends it off the back foot
bowls short of length on the leg stump line, the batsman gets hit on the thigh pad and he takes a leg bye

complete misjudgment by Mithun at fine-leg! He runs in too much and then sees the ball go over him! The batsman walked across to the off side and tried to whack the short of length delivery to the leg side, but got a thick top edge
he bowls it back of length and on off stump, the batsman comes forward and defends it to the off side
fuller delivery from wide of the crease, the batsman comes forward and drives it to extra cover
this time he tries to punch the length ball to the off side, but he gets an inside edge on to his pads. The ball drops right in front and Gambhir calls for a quick single
he makes room for himself, but ends up playing the kind of shot that did Pujara, he mistimes his inside out drive and it just clears the extra cover fielder
length delivery on off stump, 141 kph,  the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
quick short of length delivery that takes off after pitching, Kallis sways away from the line
he bowls a length delivery on the pads, Gambhir stays on the back foot and works it away on the leg side,  behind square
another length ball, swinging away from the batsman, Kallis pushes it straight to short cover
beats the bat as Kallis tries to drive this widish length delivery away from the body
puts a lot of effort in this short of length delivery wide outside off, Kallis stays away from it, the keeper takes it head high
he bowls a length delivery outside off, it stays a touch low and comes off slow off the pitch, the batsman defends it off the back foot
he has got the wicket off the second ball! It was short of length delivery outside off that Bisla punched it away from the body, ends up slicing it head high to Henriques at point
he bowls it short of length outside off, the batsman defends it to cover off the back foot
